scope: QTEMP only (two tables, up to four triggers); reads catalogs

session.label: session
session.sql: SELECT CURRENT USER AS CURRENT_USER, QSYS2.JOB_NAME AS JOB_NAME, OS_VERSION, OS_RELEASE FROM SYSIBMADM.ENV_SYS_INFO

user_info.label: user (QSYS2.USER_INFO)
user_info.sql: SELECT AUTHORIZATION_NAME, USER_CLASS_NAME, SPECIAL_AUTHORITIES, GROUP_PROFILE_NAME, SUPPLEMENTAL_GROUP_LIST FROM QSYS2.USER_INFO WHERE AUTHORIZATION_NAME = CURRENT USER

command_privileges.label: trigger commands (QSYS2.OBJECT_PRIVILEGES)
command_privileges.sql: SELECT SYSTEM_OBJECT_NAME, AUTHORIZATION_NAME, OBJECT_AUTHORITY FROM QSYS2.OBJECT_PRIVILEGES WHERE SYSTEM_OBJECT_SCHEMA = 'QSYS' AND OBJECT_TYPE = '*CMD' AND SYSTEM_OBJECT_NAME IN ('ADDPFTRG', 'RMVPFTRG', 'CHGPFTRG') ORDER BY SYSTEM_OBJECT_NAME, AUTHORIZATION_NAME

tables.label: create DJT_ORDER
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE QTEMP.DJT_ORDER (ID INTEGER NOT NULL, STATUS VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, N INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0)

tables.label: create DJT_LOG
tables.sql: CREATE TABLE QTEMP.DJT_LOG (ID INTEGER NOT NULL, ACTION VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL)

minimal.label: minimal
minimal.sql: CREATE TRIGGER QTEMP.DJT_MIN AFTER INSERT ON QTEMP.DJT_ORDER FOR EACH ROW MODE DB2ROW INSERT INTO QTEMP.DJT_LOG VALUES (0, 'minimal')
minimal.message: [42000] [IBM][System i Access ODBC Driver][DB2 for i5/OS]SQL0552 - Not authorized to CREATE TRIGGER. (-552) (SQLExecDirectW)

after_insert.label: after_insert
after_insert.sql: CREATE TRIGGER QTEMP.DJT_AINS AFTER INSERT ON QTEMP.DJT_ORDER REFERENCING NEW AS N FOR EACH ROW MODE DB2ROW BEGIN ATOMIC INSERT INTO QTEMP.DJT_LOG VALUES (N.ID, 'insert'); END

read_only.label: read_only
read_only.sql: CREATE TRIGGER QTEMP.DJT_RO BEFORE UPDATE ON QTEMP.DJT_ORDER REFERENCING OLD AS O NEW AS N FOR EACH ROW MODE DB2ROW WHEN (O.STATUS <> N.STATUS) BEGIN ATOMIC SIGNAL SQLSTATE '75001' SET MESSAGE_TEXT = 'DJT: status is read-only'; END

fires.label: update N (status unchanged)
fires.sql: UPDATE QTEMP.DJT_ORDER SET N = 1 WHERE ID = 1

fires.label: update STATUS
fires.sql: UPDATE QTEMP.DJT_ORDER SET STATUS = 'paid' WHERE ID = 1

after.label: rows in DJT_ORDER
after.sql: SELECT ID, STATUS, N FROM QTEMP.DJT_ORDER ORDER BY ID

after.label: rows in DJT_LOG
after.sql: SELECT ID, ACTION FROM QTEMP.DJT_LOG ORDER BY ID, ACTION

after.label: trigger programs in QTEMP (OBJECT_STATISTICS)
after.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJATTRIBUTE, OBJTEXT FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('QTEMP', '*PGM')) X ORDER BY OBJNAME

after.label: catalog (QSYS2.SYSTRIGGERS)
after.sql: SELECT * FROM QSYS2.SYSTRIGGERS WHERE EVENT_OBJECT_SCHEMA = 'QTEMP' ORDER BY TRIGGER_NAME FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY
